# A Task Board example shows due dates and what is late

## Context

#21346 asks ten Task Board demonstrations; `dev` `78013b10fc` shows eight. The ninth is the sales pipeline (#21874, on the column total of #21868). The tenth is this one: #21346's body holds "a date on a card" back as an engine gap, and #21863 closes that gap (pull request #21864 renders a `dueDate` item on `Neo.board.Card`).

## The Problem

A buyer of a task board asks "can a card carry a deadline, and does the board show what is late?" No board example shows a date. Until #21863 a due date saved in the card editor was dropped from the card.

## The Architectural Reality

- `src/board/Card.mjs` and `src/board/CardItems.mjs`: a card's items; #21864 adds the due date item.
- `src/board/CardEditor.mjs`: the editor that saves the date.
- **Blocked by #21863**: this leaf starts when its pull request has merged.

## The Fix

One new example, `examples/board/dueDates`, on data generated relative to today so it never ages: an editorial or release calendar of about twenty cards across four columns, some due this week, a few overdue. Each card shows its date; an overdue card reads as overdue at a glance, in every theme. Opening a card and changing its date updates the card. One control narrows the board to what is late. One line on the first frame says what to try. The first step is a drive of #21864's item on `dev`: what it cannot do (an overdue state, a relative label such as "in 2 days") is added to the engine here if small, else it gets its own ticket and the example does not fake it.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Every card with a date shows it; overdue cards are distinguishable without colour alone.
- [ ] A date changed in the card editor shows on the card after Save.
- [ ] The dates are generated relative to today, in the example.
- [ ] No console error, at 1440×900 and at 390×844, in every theme the board examples offer.
- [ ] Its record is the tenth card in Task Board, with a cover from its first frame (through `neomjs/pages`).
- [ ] The look: the first frame at both sizes and the frame narrowed to what is late, Neo Dark, on the pull request, read cold by the reviewer's seat.

**Publication (added 22 Nov, the same for every leaf of this wave).** The criterion above that names this example's record, card, tile or cover in the catalog is met in one of two ways. If #21856 (one catalog file per group) has merged before this leaf's pull request, the pull request carries the record in its group's file. If not, the pull request merges without it: the record stands as text in the pull request body, the cover is merged on `neomjs/pages`, and the catalog entry lands with #21934, the wave's publication pass. Either way this leaf closes with its example.

## Out of Scope

Reminders, a calendar view of the cards, sorting columns by date in the engine. The sales pipeline (#21874).

## Avoided Traps

- **Fixed dates.** A board whose deadlines are all in November 2026 is all overdue by December.
